summary: L-4 cab on a 20 ft pole tower, Bitterroot NF; built 1939 (one source says 1938), gone by about 1980; a 2018 report finds only a few concrete blocks.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and PNW SOTA give 1939; Weebly gives 1938. The story uses 1939 and notes the 1938 date.
firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and PNW SOTA put the loss at about 1980; Weebly gives c.1983. The story uses about 1980 and notes the later date.

Weebly quotes a 1971 newspaper item saying the Bitter Root Forest closed the lookout. firelookout.com lists 1971 as not staffed and names observers again in 1974-1975. The sources read do not say whether the closure lasted more than one season.
PNW SOTA calls the summit Bad Luck Mountain. Its details (a structure from 1939 to about 1980, Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness, Paradise road) match this lookout.

sources.title: Bad Luck Point Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Dates conflict across sources (built 1938 vs 1939; removed about 1980 vs c.1983) and the story says so. Today's condition rests on one 2018 amateur-radio activation report, so check before printing. The report also mentions the 1972 Bad Luck Fire; no source ties that fire to the lookout, so the story leaves it out. The Montana Historical Society Facebook post on that fire could not be read. Staff years come from firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; the 1976 name appears only on Idaho Fire Lookouts. Brief record matches: L-4, 6.1 m, gone, Bitterroot NF. No corrections proposed.
